title.name: KID CHISPA
title.subtitle: AND THE SEVEN BELTS
scout.dock_goon: A harbor tough who shoves first and asks never. No tricks.
scout.spiky_bouncer: Wears a studded vest. Jumping on it is a bad idea.
scout.gull_flyer: Flies over the ring. Only aerial moves can reach it.
hub.title: DEV HUB
hub.subtitle: Shared foundations · test bench
hub.field.desc: Walk a grey-box room, bump an enemy, fight, come back.
hub.input.desc: See every action light up on keyboard, gamepad or touch.
hub.ui.desc: Panels, menus, bars and the confirm dialog.
hub.anim.desc: Animations built from frame names, plus palette swaps.
hub.data.desc: What the Database loaded and any problems it found.
hub.debug_hint: Debug menu: F1, or triple-tap the top-left corner
move.chop.desc: A sharp chop to the opponent in front.
move.elbow_drop.desc: Leap onto any opponent and drop an elbow twice.
move.body_slam.desc: Lift the opponent in front and slam them down.
battle.defend.desc: Brace yourself: take 1 less damage per hit until your next turn.
battle.reason.noTarget: No opponent can be reached with this move.
battle.reason.spiky: Can't land on a spiky opponent.
battle.reason.airborne: Can't reach an opponent in the air.
battle.reason.notFront: Only reaches the opponent in front.
battle.defeat_note: Game over comes later. For now you get back up with full HP.
scout.sparring_dummy: A padded practice dummy. Lots of HP, barely hits back. For practising timing.
scout.ringside_bruiser: Winds up a Running Lariat every other round. Land a GREAT hit while he's charging to stagger him.
scout.corner_medic: Patches up hurt teammates instead of fighting. Take him out first.
battle.results.title: RESULTS
hub.sandbox.desc: Build any fight, play it or simulate it 200 times. Your save is never touched.
move.mic_drop.desc: Pip bounces up and drops the mic on any opponent, even one in the air.
move.scout.desc: Pip sizes up an opponent: HP, attack, defence and what to watch out for.
battle.partner_down_note: {name} is down and will get back up after the fight.
field.bag_full: Your bag is full. You leave the {item} where it is for now.
field.locked.octagon: The gate to the Octagon is chained shut.
npc.dock_kid.1: You want into the Octagon? Nobody gets in without knowing someone.
npc.dock_kid.2: Lucky for you, I know everyone. There, the gate's open.
npc.dock_kid.after: Go on, the gate's open. Don't tell anyone it was me.
sign.octagon: EAST: THE OCTAGON. Fighters only. No refunds.
trigger.test_a: (A story trigger fired here. It only happens once.)
hub.editor.desc: Build and change rooms on a top-down plan, then walk around them. Saves to the game link.
